name: Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland (LVNL)
notes: lvnl.nl (Dutch home page, title 'Luchtverkeersleiding Nederland | LVNL') presents LVNL as the Dutch air traffic control organisation ('Vliegverkeer in veilige handen'). The logo is only embedded as an inline SVG sprite symbol (#icon-logo-lvnl in /svg/sprite.svg) with no standalone logo file; the press page (/contact/pers-en-media) links only to a photo/video image bank (beeldbank), with no logos or brand guidelines. A shared icon sprite is not stored as a logo.

gaps.need: logo files (all variants) and brand guidelines
gaps.reason: lvnl.nl embeds its logo only as an SVG sprite symbol; press page offers no logo pack or brand page

contact.notes: Press and media page located; no logo-specific address read.
